summary: Configured and validated the durable TLS-enabled Vault Transit provider and three-member Raft HA cluster. No disruptive reboots or failures were injected.
actions_performed: Installed Vault 2.0.4 and enabled services on all nodes.
Configured node1 as file-backed Shamir Transit provider with narrowly scoped seal token.
Configured node2–node4 with integrated Raft, Transit auto-unseal, and persistent retry joining.
Installed shared CA and validated per-node TLS certificates for API and cluster identities.
Enabled versioned KV at secret/ and stored the required proof value.
Created root-only administrative environments and protected all tokens, recovery material, and private keys.
Enabled persistent UFW rules with Vault ports restricted to the cluster subnet.
Validated three healthy voters, Autopilot failure tolerance of 1, authenticated secret reads, TLS health, and permissions.
